text_block_list.text:
At dusk. While taking a heartwarming 
stroll with Wonder Acute...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? Dear Trainer, there seems to be a 
crowd up ahead...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be that some heavyweight 
champion has graced us with their 
presence?"

It didn't feel like an autograph session 
or a street fight was about to break out. 
Drawing a bit closer—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up! Come try the fun, exciting 
lottery draw! Hey, gentle-looking 
Umamusume over there, care to draw a 
ticket?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, a raffle lottery. What 
fortunate timing to come across this.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, wanna go spin the lottery wheel? 
Come to think of it, I got a ticket when I 
bought that bead set at the sewing shop...

There was indeed just one ticket left. I 
handed it to the uncle from the shopping 
district—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer-san, let's spin round 
and rooound together~

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Let's take a whole bunch of souvenirs back 
home. One, two, and... threeee!

"We spin the raffle drum together. And the 
result is—"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hyoeeeeee!? Well, well, well... Color me 
flabbergasted, y'all!!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, it's the grand prize! To think we 
get to go to a hot spring cure. How 
wonderful, I'm so grateful...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? Did I say something strange? Hot 
springs are for healing scrapes and 
bruises, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"I wanna give that head of yours, which is 
always bumping and clashing, a nice, cozy 
rest♪"

...Now that you mention it, calling it a 
hot-spring cure makes total sense. For an 
Umamusume who races hard, hot springs are 
also a form of 'medical therapy.'

"It proved to have immense value, far 
beyond mere recreation."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, I'd like to go right away if 
possible, but I suppose it won't be that 
simple.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
A race with Falco-san is waiting just 
ahead. Even though I can't go there 
myself...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, Trainer, are you heading out on 
your own?

First of all, I want to take Wonder Acute 
to a hot spring. When I told her that...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see. Much obliged. Your kindness 
really warms my heart. Well then...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
How about we head out around next spring? 
Just the two of us, taking it nice and 
easy.

A hot spring trip to reward their hard 
work. It looks like I'll at least be able 
to show some filial piety.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's decided, I certainly can't 
afford to put up any shameful results, can 
I?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for the carrot right in front of 
me, I'm gonna "hustle"! Fuhoh!

With her sights set on the ultimate trip, 
Wonder Acute's morale surged 
significantly!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh... You won something that looks like 
it'll give you plenty of stamina♪

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
A carrot right in the middle of a hamburg 
steak... In order to enjoy this even more 
deliciously...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ohoho, that's right! Trainer-san, let's 
take this home right away. I've just had a 
stroke of brilliant wisdom.

And so, we brought back the Premium Carrot 
Hamburg Steak to cook it—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Did you go and eat only the 
carrots first?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I did as I was told, but...
Yeah, I did just as you said, but...

text_block_list.text:
A gaping hole right in the center. And 
into it—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Here's your seconds~. Heeeee-yaaah!
(BOOOM!)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's right. This makes it even more 
nutritious, right?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, I guess I'll eat too. The 'Special 
Radish Salisbury Steak'♪ You can only get 
it here, after all!

An unexpected original dish was born. The 
Salisbury steak, spiked with an extra 
topping of "daikon radish," was packed 
with extra nutrition.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oho oho, my my... That's quite a haul you 
won~

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Truly perfect for this season. Don't you 
think so, Trainer?

I felt bewildered for a second. What does 
it mean for carrots to be perfect for 
winter?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Can't you tell? This is how you use a 
whole mountain of carrots~."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"All warm and cozy in the room♪ With a 
huge, towering pile of carrots right on 
the table."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If you do this, you can snack while 
watching TV, right? Now this is pure 
bliss.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Come now, dear Trainer. Eat as much as 
your heart desires.

Carrots instead of mandarin oranges under 
the kotatsu. A heartwarming idea that was 
quintessentially Wonder Acute.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
One stick... Only a single one, huh... 
Well now, that's rather lonesome.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Even for a hungry Trainer, this wouldn't 
be enough to fill your tummy at all!"
(Thud...!)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Oh, Trainer! Pull yourself 
together!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Soon... Grandpa will bring something back 
soon. Aaaah..."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: And so, that happened...
choice_data_list: I told you, it's not gonna happen!

text_block_list.text:
I was almost turned into some kind of 
folkloric sacrifice.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Well, as long as it's fine by 
you.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, at least eat the whole thing 
yourself. Don't worry about me.
choice_data_list: No, let's split it in half.
No, let's split it half and half.

text_block_list.text:
Stopping Wonder Acute as she tried to give 
it all away, we split it in half. It was 
just a small portion, but it had a gentle 
flavor.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Haee... Toilet paper... Who would've 
thought it'd be toilet paper?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, I can't do anything at all. 
The only thing I could do is...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you don't have a nosebleed, do 
you? Because if you do...
choice_data_list: Sorry, it didn't really come out.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, your nose isn't running, is it? 
Because if it is...
choice_data_list: I wonder if it came out yet.
Looks like they're not out yet.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm, we're in a tough spot. Trainer-san, 
is there... is there anything else...?"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Got anything coming out of your nose, by 
any chance?

There was nothing scheduled to come out. 
With no useful way to spend the tissues, 
Wonder Acute looked rather disappointed.
